// Program API runtime of the exported Ink UI (generated by TUI Studio, do not edit).
//
// The UI runs next to your program: `ui.start()` renders it without blocking, you talk to the
// components through typed handles, and the UI talks back with events.
//
//   const ui = new Ui();
//   await ui.start();
//   ui.submitBtn.onClick((e) => { ui.status.text = "clicked"; });
//   ui.nameInput.readonly();
//   await ui.wait();

import { render } from "ink";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";

export type UiState = "active" | "muted" | "readonly" | "hidden";
export type ValueType = "str" | "int" | "float" | "bool" | "str_list" | "rows";
export type Rows = string[][];

export class UiError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "UiError";
  }
}

export interface UiEvent {
  tag: string;
  name: string;
  value: unknown;
  time: number;
}

export interface ErrorEntry {
  message: string;
  details: string;
  time: number;
}

export type LogLevel = "debug" | "info" | "warning" | "error";

export interface LogEntry {
  level: LogLevel;
  message: string;
  time: number;
}

export interface PropSpec {
  type: ValueType;
  value: unknown;
}

export interface HandleSpec {
  tag: string;
  type: string;
  states: UiState[];
  state: UiState;
  props: Record<string, PropSpec>;
  /** Modals: initially open. */
  open?: boolean;
}

interface Entry {
  spec: HandleSpec;
  state: UiState;
  props: Record<string, unknown>;
  open: boolean;
}

export type Handler = (event: UiEvent) => unknown;

function coerce(type: ValueType, value: unknown, what: string): unknown {
  switch (type) {
    case "str":
      return typeof value === "string" ? value : value == null ? "" : String(value);
    case "bool":
      return Boolean(value);
    case "int":
    case "float": {
      const n = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) throw new UiError(what + " needs a number, got " + String(value));
      return type === "int" ? Math.trunc(n) : n;
    }
    case "str_list":
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new UiError(what + " needs a list");
      return value.map((v) => String(v));
    case "rows":
      if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.some((r) => !Array.isArray(r))) {
        throw new UiError(what + " needs a list of rows");
      }
      return (value as unknown[][]).map((r) => r.map((c) => String(c)));
  }
}

/** The shared state of the UI: what the components show, their states, events, errors and log. */
export class UiCore {
  private entries = new Map<string, Entry>();
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private version = 0;
  private handlers = new Map<string, Handler[]>();
  private queue: UiEvent[] = [];
  private waiters: ((e: UiEvent | null) => void)[] = [];

  errors: ErrorEntry[] = [];
  logEntries: LogEntry[] = [];
  /** Errors the user has not dismissed yet (shown in the dialog). */
  pending: ErrorEntry[] = [];
  logOpen = false;
  ready = false;
  running = false;

  constructor(specs: HandleSpec[]) {
    for (const spec of specs) {
      const props: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const [k, p] of Object.entries(spec.props)) props[k] = p.value;
      this.entries.set(spec.tag, { spec, state: spec.state, props, open: spec.open ?? false });
    }
  }

  // ── Store (React reads it with useSyncExternalStore) ─────────────────────────

  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      this.listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  };

  snapshot = (): number => this.version;

  private changed(): void {
    this.version++;
    for (const l of [...this.listeners]) l();
  }

  private entry(tag: string): Entry {
    const e = this.entries.get(tag);
    if (!e) throw new UiError("unknown component " + tag);
    return e;
  }

  state(tag: string): UiState {
    return this.entries.get(tag)?.state ?? "active";
  }
  isOpen(tag: string): boolean {
    return this.entries.get(tag)?.open ?? false;
  }
  get(tag: string, name: string): unknown {
    return this.entry(tag).props[name];
  }
  str(tag: string, name: string): string {
    return String(this.get(tag, name) ?? "");
  }
  num(tag: string, name: string): number {
    return Number(this.get(tag, name) ?? 0);
  }
  bool(tag: string, name: string): boolean {
    return Boolean(this.get(tag, name));
  }
  list(tag: string, name: string): string[] {
    return (this.get(tag, name) as string[] | null) ?? [];
  }
  rows(tag: string, name: string): Rows {
    return (this.get(tag, name) as Rows | null) ?? [];
  }

  // ── Program side (never fires events) ────────────────────────────────────────

  setProp(tag: string, name: string, value: unknown): void {
    const e = this.entry(tag);
    const p = e.spec.props[name];
    if (!p) throw new UiError(tag + " has no property " + name);
    e.props[name] = coerce(p.type, value, tag + "." + name);
    this.changed();
  }

  setState(tag: string, state: UiState): void {
    const e = this.entry(tag);
    if (!e.spec.states.includes(state)) {
      throw new UiError(e.spec.type + " " + tag + " does not support the state " + state);
    }
    e.state = state;
    this.changed();
  }

  setOpen(tag: string, open: boolean): void {
    this.entry(tag).open = open;
    this.changed();
  }

  // ── User side ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** The user changed a property: stored and announced, unless the component is not active. */
  user(tag: string, name: string, value: unknown, event?: string): boolean {
    const e = this.entry(tag);
    if (e.state !== "active") return false;
    e.props[name] = value;
    this.changed();
    if (event) this.emit(tag, event, value);
    return true;
  }

  /** The user did something without a value change (click, submit). */
  fire(tag: string, event: string, value?: unknown): boolean {
    if (this.entry(tag).state !== "active") return false;
    this.emit(tag, event, value);
    return true;
  }

  // ── Events ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  addHandler(tag: string, event: string, fn: Handler): void {
    const key = tag + "\u0000" + event;
    const list = this.handlers.get(key) ?? [];
    list.push(fn);
    this.handlers.set(key, list);
  }

  private emit(tag: string, name: string, value: unknown): void {
    const event: UiEvent = { tag, name, value, time: Date.now() };
    const waiter = this.waiters.shift();
    if (waiter) waiter(event);
    else this.queue.push(event);
    const list = this.handlers.get(tag + "\u0000" + name) ?? [];
    // Handlers run later, off the render path, so a slow handler cannot freeze the UI.
    for (const fn of list) {
      setImmediate(() => {
        try {
          Promise.resolve(fn(event)).catch((err) => this.report(err));
        } catch (err) {
          this.report(err);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  nextEvent(timeoutMs?: number): Promise<UiEvent | null> {
    const queued = this.queue.shift();
    if (queued) return Promise.resolve(queued);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      const waiter = (e: UiEvent | null) => {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(e);
      };
      this.waiters.push(waiter);
      if (timeoutMs != null) {
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
          const i = this.waiters.indexOf(waiter);
          if (i >= 0) this.waiters.splice(i, 1);
          resolve(null);
        }, timeoutMs);
      }
    });
  }

  // ── Errors and log ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  report(error: unknown, details = ""): ErrorEntry {
    const isErr = error instanceof Error;
    const entry: ErrorEntry = {
      message: isErr ? error.message || error.name : String(error),
      details: details || (isErr ? (error.stack ?? "") : ""),
      time: Date.now(),
    };
    this.errors.push(entry);
    this.pending.push(entry);
    this.log("error", entry.message);
    return entry;
  }

  dismissDialog(): void {
    if (!this.pending.length) return;
    this.pending = [];
    this.changed();
  }

  log(level: LogLevel, message: unknown): void {
    this.logEntries.push({ level, message: String(message), time: Date.now() });
    if (this.logEntries.length > 500) this.logEntries.shift();
    this.changed();
  }

  toggleLog(): void {
    this.logOpen = !this.logOpen;
    this.changed();
  }

  // ── Mouse ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private hits: HitTarget[] = [];

  /** Make a rendered element clickable. Returns the function that removes it again. */
  addHit(target: HitTarget): () => void {
    this.hits.push(target);
    return () => {
      this.hits = this.hits.filter((h) => h !== target);
    };
  }

  /**
   * A left click at screen cell (x, y), 0-based. An open error dialog takes the click (and
   * closes); while a modal is shown only the modal's own components can be clicked.
   */
  click(x: number, y: number): void {
    if (this.pending.length) {
      setImmediate(() => this.dismissDialog());
      return;
    }
    const modal = this.hits.some((h) => h.modal);
    const view = rectOf(this.viewRef?.current);
    let best: HitTarget | null = null;
    let bestArea = Infinity;
    for (const h of this.hits) {
      if (modal && h.layer < 1) continue;
      const r = rectOf(h.ref.current);
      if (!r || x < r.x || x >= r.x + r.width || y < r.y || y >= r.y + r.height) continue;
      if (h.layer < 1 && view && (y < view.y || y >= view.y + view.height)) continue;
      const area = r.width * r.height;
      if (area <= bestArea) {
        best = h;
        bestArea = area;
      }
    }
    if (best) {
      try {
        best.cb(x, y);
      } catch (err) {
        // A broken click must never end the app.
        this.report(err);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Scrolling (the screen content is shifted inside a fixed viewport) ───────────

  /** Rows the content is scrolled up. */
  scroll = 0;
  contentHeight = 0;
  viewHeight = 0;
  viewWidth = 0;
  /** The viewport element (set by the UI) and the scroll bar state. */
  viewRef: { current: unknown } | null = null;

  maxScroll(): number {
    return Math.max(0, this.contentHeight - this.viewHeight);
  }

  /** Called by the UI after every layout. */
  setMetrics(content: number, view: number, width: number): void {
    if (content === this.contentHeight && view === this.viewHeight && width === this.viewWidth) return;
    this.contentHeight = content;
    this.viewHeight = view;
    this.viewWidth = width;
    this.scroll = Math.min(this.scroll, this.maxScroll());
    this.changed();
  }

  scrollTo(row: number): void {
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.maxScroll(), Math.round(row)));
    if (next === this.scroll) return;
    this.scroll = next;
    this.changed();
  }

  scrollBy(rows: number): void {
    this.scrollTo(this.scroll + rows);
  }

  /** Scroll so that the screen rows [top, bottom) are inside the viewport. */
  reveal(top: number, bottom: number): void {
    const view = rectOf(this.viewRef?.current);
    if (!view) return;
    if (top < view.y) this.scrollBy(top - view.y);
    else if (bottom > view.y + view.height) this.scrollBy(Math.min(bottom - (view.y + view.height), top - view.y));
  }
}

export interface Rect {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface HitTarget {
  ref: { current: unknown };
  /** 0 for the screen, 1 inside a modal. */
  layer: number;
  /** The modal's own box (it swallows clicks inside it). */
  modal?: boolean;
  cb: (x: number, y: number) => void;
}

interface YogaNodeLike {
  getComputedLeft(): number;
  getComputedTop(): number;
  getComputedWidth(): number;
  getComputedHeight(): number;
}
interface DomNodeLike {
  yogaNode?: YogaNodeLike;
  parentNode?: DomNodeLike | null;
}

/**
 * Where an Ink element is on screen: its own size from Yoga and the sum of the computed
 * offsets of all its ancestors (Ink has no API for this, but its elements expose `yogaNode`
 * and `parentNode`). The root of the UI is drawn at the top left of the terminal.
 */
export function rectOf(element: unknown): Rect | null {
  let node = (element ?? null) as DomNodeLike | null;
  if (!node?.yogaNode) return null;
  const width = node.yogaNode.getComputedWidth();
  const height = node.yogaNode.getComputedHeight();
  let x = 0;
  let y = 0;
  while (node?.yogaNode) {
    x += node.yogaNode.getComputedLeft();
    y += node.yogaNode.getComputedTop();
    node = node.parentNode ?? null;
  }
  return { x, y, width, height };
}

const MOUSE_ON = "\u001b[?1000h\u001b[?1006h";
const MOUSE_OFF = "\u001b[?1006l\u001b[?1000l";
// SGR mouse report: ESC [ < button ; column ; row (M = press, m = release)
const MOUSE_RE = /\u001b?\[<(\d+);(\d+);(\d+)([Mm])/g;
// The beginning of a report at the very end of the input: ESC, ESC [, ESC [ < 1 ; 2 ... (or the same without the ESC)
const MOUSE_PARTIAL_RE = /(?:\u001b(?:\[(?:<[\d;]*)?)?|\[(?:<[\d;]*)?)$/;
const MOUSE_HOLD_MS = 80;

// ── Handles ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class Handle {
  constructor(
    protected readonly core: UiCore,
    readonly tag: string,
  ) {}

  get state(): UiState {
    return this.core.state(this.tag);
  }
  active(): void {
    this.core.setState(this.tag, "active");
  }
  mute(): void {
    this.core.setState(this.tag, "muted");
  }
  readonly(): void {
    this.core.setState(this.tag, "readonly");
  }
  hide(): void {
    this.core.setState(this.tag, "hidden");
  }
  /** Back to `active` from hidden. */
  show(): void {
    if (this.state === "hidden") this.active();
  }

  protected set(name: string, value: unknown): void {
    this.core.setProp(this.tag, name, value);
  }
  protected on(event: string, fn: Handler): this {
    this.core.addHandler(this.tag, event, fn);
    return this;
  }
}

export class ContainerHandle extends Handle {}

export class TextHandle extends Handle {
  get text(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "text"); }
  set text(v: unknown) { this.set("text", v); }
}
export class SpinnerHandle extends Handle {
  get label(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "label"); }
  set label(v: unknown) { this.set("label", v); }
}
export class ButtonHandle extends Handle {
  get label(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "label"); }
  set label(v: unknown) { this.set("label", v); }
  onClick(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("click", fn); }
}
export class TextInputHandle extends Handle {
  get value(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "value"); }
  set value(v: unknown) { this.set("value", v); }
  get placeholder(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "placeholder"); }
  set placeholder(v: unknown) { this.set("placeholder", v); }
  onChange(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("change", fn); }
  onSubmit(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("submit", fn); }
}
class CheckedHandle extends Handle {
  get checked(): boolean { return this.core.bool(this.tag, "checked"); }
  set checked(v: unknown) { this.set("checked", v); }
  get label(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "label"); }
  set label(v: unknown) { this.set("label", v); }
  onChange(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("change", fn); }
}
export class CheckboxHandle extends CheckedHandle {}
export class RadioHandle extends CheckedHandle {}
export class ToggleHandle extends CheckedHandle {}
export class SelectHandle extends Handle {
  get value(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "value"); }
  set value(v: unknown) { this.set("value", v); }
  get options(): string[] { return this.core.list(this.tag, "options"); }
  set options(v: unknown) { this.set("options", v); }
  onChange(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("change", fn); }
}
export class ProgressBarHandle extends Handle {
  get value(): number { return this.core.num(this.tag, "value"); }
  set value(v: unknown) { this.set("value", v); }
  get max(): number { return this.core.num(this.tag, "max"); }
  set max(v: unknown) { this.set("max", v); }
}
export class TableHandle extends Handle {
  get columns(): string[] { return this.core.list(this.tag, "columns"); }
  set columns(v: unknown) { this.set("columns", v); }
  get rows(): Rows { return this.core.rows(this.tag, "rows"); }
  set rows(v: unknown) { this.set("rows", v); }
  addRow(...cells: unknown[]): void { this.set("rows", [...this.rows, cells.map(String)]); }
  clear(): void { this.set("rows", []); }
}
export class ListHandle extends Handle {
  get items(): string[] { return this.core.list(this.tag, "items"); }
  set items(v: unknown) { this.set("items", v); }
  get selected(): number { return this.core.num(this.tag, "selected"); }
  set selected(v: unknown) { this.set("selected", v); }
  onSelect(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("select", fn); }
}
export class TreeHandle extends Handle {
  onSelect(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("select", fn); }
}
export class MenuHandle extends Handle {
  get selected(): number { return this.core.num(this.tag, "selected"); }
  set selected(v: unknown) { this.set("selected", v); }
  onSelect(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("select", fn); }
}
export class TabsHandle extends Handle {
  get activeTab(): number { return this.core.num(this.tag, "active_tab"); }
  set activeTab(v: unknown) { this.set("active_tab", v); }
  onChange(fn: Handler): this { return this.on("change", fn); }
}
export class ModalHandle extends Handle {
  get title(): string { return this.core.str(this.tag, "title"); }
  set title(v: unknown) { this.set("title", v); }
  get isOpen(): boolean { return this.core.isOpen(this.tag); }
  open(): void { this.core.setOpen(this.tag, true); }
  close(): void { this.core.setOpen(this.tag, false); }
}

// ── The facade base class ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RenderedApp {
  unmount(): void;
  waitUntilExit?(): Promise<unknown>;
}

export interface UiOptions {
  /** How the UI element is rendered (default: Ink's `render` on stdout). Tests pass their own. */
  render?: (element: ReactElement) => RenderedApp;
  /** Mouse reporting on a terminal (default true). Clicks work like keys. */
  mouse?: boolean;
}

export abstract class UiBase {
  readonly core: UiCore;
  readonly log: {
    debug(message: unknown): void;
    info(message: unknown): void;
    warning(message: unknown): void;
    error(message: unknown): void;
    readonly entries: readonly LogEntry[];
  };
  private app: RenderedApp | null = null;
  private closed: Promise<void>;
  private closeNow!: () => void;
  private readyNow!: () => void;
  private readyPromise: Promise<void>;

  protected constructor(
    specs: HandleSpec[],
    private readonly options: UiOptions = {},
  ) {
    const core = new UiCore(specs);
    this.core = core;
    this.log = {
      debug: (m) => core.log("debug", m),
      info: (m) => core.log("info", m),
      warning: (m) => core.log("warning", m),
      error: (m) => core.log("error", m),
      get entries() {
        return core.logEntries;
      },
    };
    this.closed = new Promise((r) => (this.closeNow = r));
    this.readyPromise = new Promise((r) => (this.readyNow = r));
  }

  protected abstract element(): ReactElement;

  get ready(): boolean {
    return this.core.ready;
  }
  get running(): boolean {
    return this.core.running;
  }
  get errors(): readonly ErrorEntry[] {
    return this.core.errors;
  }

  /** Called by the UI once it is on screen. */
  markReady(): void {
    this.core.ready = true;
    this.readyNow();
  }

  /** Start the UI next to the program; resolves when it is ready. */
  async start(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.core.running) return;
    this.core.running = true;
    const renderer = this.options.render ?? ((el: ReactElement) => render(el));
    this.app = renderer(this.element());
    this.app.waitUntilExit?.().then(
      () => this.close(),
      () => this.close(),
    );
    await this.readyPromise;
  }

  /** Start the UI, run `main(ui)` next to it and return when the UI closes. */
  async run(main: (ui: this) => unknown): Promise<void> {
    await this.start();
    void Promise.resolve()
      .then(() => main(this))
      .catch((err) => this.report(err));
    await this.wait();
  }

  /** Close the UI. */
  stop(): void {
    if (this.app && this.core.running) {
      try {
        this.app.unmount();
      } catch {
        /* already closed */
      }
    }
    this.close();
  }

  /** Resolves when the UI is closed. */
  wait(): Promise<void> {
    return this.core.running ? this.closed : Promise.resolve();
  }

  private close(): void {
    if (!this.core.running) return;
    this.core.running = false;
    this.closeNow();
  }

  /** Open the error dialog, add the error to `errors` and the log. */
  report(error: unknown, details = ""): void {
    this.core.report(error, details);
  }

  /** The next event of any component (null after `timeoutMs`). */
  nextEvent(timeoutMs?: number): Promise<UiEvent | null> {
    return this.core.nextEvent(timeoutMs);
  }

  /**
   * Called by the UI once it is on screen: turns on mouse reporting (on a terminal) and takes
   * the mouse reports out of the input before Ink reads it. Returns the clean-up function.
   */
  attachTerminal(stdin: any, stdout: any): () => void {
    const undo: (() => void)[] = [];
    const original = stdin?.read;
    if (typeof original === "function") {
      // A terminal may deliver a report in pieces (Windows Terminal hands it over key by key), so
      // the beginning of one is held back until it is complete. If nothing follows within a few
      // milliseconds it was not a report (a lone Esc, say) and goes on to Ink.
      let held = "";
      let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      const released: string[] = [];
      stdin.read = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        if (released.length) return released.shift();
        for (;;) {
          const chunk = original.apply(stdin, args);
          if (chunk == null) return chunk;
          const { rest, tail } = this.takeMouse(held + (typeof chunk === "string" ? chunk : String(chunk)));
          held = tail;
          if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
          timer = null;
          if (held) {
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
              timer = null;
              if (!held) return;
              released.push(held);
              held = "";
              stdin.emit("readable");
            }, MOUSE_HOLD_MS);
          }
          // Everything was a mouse report: look at the next chunk (never end the read early).
          if (rest !== "") return rest;
        }
      };
      undo.push(() => {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        stdin.read = original;
      });
    }
    if (this.options.mouse !== false && stdout?.isTTY) {
      stdout.write(MOUSE_ON);
      const off = () => stdout.write(MOUSE_OFF);
      process.once("exit", off);
      undo.push(() => {
        process.off("exit", off);
        off();
      });
    }
    return () => {
      for (const u of undo.reverse()) u();
    };
  }

  /**
   * Takes the mouse reports out of `text` and acts on them. Returns the other input, and the
   * beginning of a report that is cut off at the end of the chunk (to be completed by the next one).
   */
  takeMouse(text: string): { rest: string; tail: string } {
    const rest = text.replace(MOUSE_RE, (_all, b: string, x: string, y: string, kind: string) => {
      try {
        const button = Number(b);
        if (button & 64) {
          // Wheel: 64 = up, 65 = down (3 rows per notch).
          if (!this.core.pending.length) this.core.scrollBy((button & 1 ? 1 : -1) * 3);
        } else if (kind === "M" && button === 0) {
          // Left button pressed (no motion, no modifiers).
          this.core.click(Number(x) - 1, Number(y) - 1);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        this.core.report(err);
      }
      return "";
    });
    const cut = MOUSE_PARTIAL_RE.exec(rest);
    return cut ? { rest: rest.slice(0, cut.index), tail: cut[0] } : { rest, tail: "" };
  }

  /** Report errors of your own program that nobody caught. */
  installExcepthooks(): void {
    process.on("uncaughtException", (e) => this.report(e));
    process.on("unhandledRejection", (e) => this.report(e));
  }
}
